Номер бронирования

A unique identifier assigned by the carrier or NVOCC to each shipment booking, used for cargo tracking, documentation, and operational reference.

Questions and answers

What is Номер бронирования?

In this glossary, Номер бронирования refers to: A unique identifier assigned by the carrier or NVOCC to each shipment booking, used for cargo tracking, documentation, and operational reference.

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Номер бронирования должен быть указан во всех транспортных документах и на контейнерных этикетках для отслеживания и выдачи."

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A unique identifier assigned by the carrier or NVOCC to each shipment booking, used for cargo tracking, documentation, and operational reference.

Operational example

The booking number must be included on all shipping documents and container labels for tracking and release.
